purpose: Centralizes Go/Zen wiring in a Catalog registry, extracts a shared RequestFactory, and splits long methods with no behavior change.
riskRationale: Pure refactor with all 8 prior findings verified fixed; phpcs clean and 46 tests / 151 assertions pass.

text: The maintainability refactor is sound and complete. All 8 previously reported minor issues were verified fixed in the current tree (version tags re-synced to 0.1.4, subclass-safe header policy, validated cache keys, lock-safe probe, loud MIME failures, list fast-path hashing, documented fail-fast throws, guarded RequestFactory). Hard rules hold: separate Go/Zen settings, credential-blind bust hooks, versions in sync.

reasoning: All 4 specialized subagents (security, performance, quality, logic) failed to dispatch (free-tier tool restriction), so a direct fallback review was performed: all prior findings verified fixed, hard rules intact, phpcs exit 0 and phpunit OK (46 tests, 151 assertions), and no new reportable issues found.

message: transient_key() now validates via require_valid(), closing the cache-key injection surface.
Probe construction moved inside try/catch so the stampede lock always clears via store_result().
should_send_for() uses is_a() so Go subclasses keep the required session header.
mime_to_extension() throws loudly on unmapped types instead of silently saving with the wrong extension.
for_provider() guards with class_exists/method_exists and throws a catchable InvalidArgumentException.
